findings.description: Frontend dummy detail builder diverges on payments.outlet_id. buildDummyInvoiceDetail maps payments with outlet_id: invoice.order_id (copying order id) instead of the order/outlet id, while backend InvoiceService::getDetail and DummySeeder cache use real $payment->outlet_id. Detail shape keys match but value contract diverges; not caught by T7 detail.test which only checks amount/status, and T6 DummyInvoiceParityTest only checks backend cache. Cross-task dummy parity mismatch.

Spec Implementation Notes feature flag invoice_pdf for progressive rollout is not implemented by any Phase 2 task and no task packet mentions it. Migration/route guard remains unconditional. Spec-level gap left uncovered by task split; low risk as rollback notes handle removal but rollout gating is missing.
